cr_mode.schema:
CREATE TABLE cred_policy (
  tenant_id text NOT NULL,
  connector text NOT NULL,
  zone text NOT NULL CHECK (zone IN ('company','team','personal')),
  mode text NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('app_only','user_grant','both','none')),
  changed_by text NOT NULL,
  changed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, connector, zone),
  CHECK (zone <> 'personal' OR mode IN ('user_grant','none'))
);
CREATE TABLE tenant_cred (tenant_id text PRIMARY KEY, strict boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false);
cr_mode.interface: def decide(tenant: str, connector: str, zone: str, credential_kind: str, user_id: str | None) -> Decision  # Decision(allow, reason); credential_kind is app_only or user_grant

cr_gap.schema:
CREATE TABLE gap_user (
  tenant_id text NOT NULL,
  user_id text NOT NULL,
  app text NOT NULL,
  sampled int NOT NULL,
  missing int NOT NULL,
  total_estimate bigint,
  at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, user_id, app)
);
CREATE VIEW gap_admin AS
  SELECT tenant_id, app, count(*) AS users, sum(missing) AS missing, sum(sampled) AS sampled
  FROM gap_user GROUP BY tenant_id, app HAVING count(*) >= 5;
cr_gap.interface: def probe(user: LinkedUser, app: str, n: int = 400) -> GapEstimate  # GapEstimate(p_hat, margin, gap_total | None, enough_data)
